artifacts.finding: The Cornell enclosure, red and green walls, ceiling emitter, floor, ceiling, back wall, tall box and short box are recognizable with correct top-left viewing orientation and no crop or row-order corruption.
The 1080p artifact preserves the same geometry, framing, color separation and emitter placement as the 720p artifact without missing regions, non-finite pixels or transport corruption.

observations: The gray outer field is consistent with the retained camera framing and scene background rather than an orientation or aspect-ratio defect.

Monte Carlo noise remains visible at 128 spp, especially on low-energy surfaces; this is expected before the later reconstruction and denoising phases and is not represented as final Preview image quality.
The emitter reaches the bright end of the fixed viewing transform, while the authoritative raw maximum remains finite and bounded by the automated report.
No NaN pattern, checkerboard fallback, torn shared-memory frame, duplicated scanline, color-channel permutation or visible Direct/Worker transport artifact was observed.
boundary: This review establishes PRV.1R product-path image integrity and quality-tier evidence only. It does not declare UltraRender_preview, complete material coverage, reconstruction maturity or denoising quality.
